title: Moving
content: Any of you searching for places to live in your world?? I keep moving and moving and living in different styles of housing. When I do end up finding my own space there’s a huge open floor pan with random people. Usually share it with several people and I always remember them, they’re my mall world friends. When it’s time for me to move, something out of my control happens. There’s either a huge storm, hurricane, shooting, fire, or a situation where the space is not being safe. I’m always traveling too, I feel like my world is so big yet I’m taking the same transportation modes. Plane, rocket, train, gondola, to get to and from where I need to be. I live my normal dream world and then all of a sudden, I have to move. Let me know your thoughts / interpretations
